abstract: Cortical cerebellar degeneration was found in a 28-year-old man with testicular neoplasm. The patient, who had undergone a left orchidectomy for the testicular tumor, developed progressive cerebellar symptoms with mental changes 7 months later. The autopsy revealed the spread of a malignant germ cell tumor of the testis, and cortical cerebellar degeneration in the central nervous system (CNS) which was characterized by almost complete loss of Purkinje cells and degeneration of the both dentate nuclei and superior cerebellar peduncles. The present case is the first of cortical cerebellar degeneration combined with testicular neoplasms.
abstract_ja: 28歳男性の精巣腫瘍例で皮質性小脳変性症が認められた。患者は精巣腫瘍に対して左精巣摘除術を受けたが、7か月後に進行性の小脳症状と精神症状が出現した。剖検では精巣の悪性胚細胞腫瘍の進展と、中枢神経系における皮質性小脳変性症が明らかになった。その特徴は、プルキンエ細胞のほぼ完全な消失と、両側歯状核および上小脳脚の変性であった。本症例は、精巣腫瘍に皮質性小脳変性症が合併した最初の報告である。
